forum.title: SKY66121-11 replacement
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @KB1DC and welcome to the ST community,

[SKY66121](https://www.mouser.fr/datasheet/3/564/1/SKY66121_11_204599H_discontinued.pdf) is not a ST product. Please contact its manufacturer for any advice.
forum.content_text: Starting to prototype a 169Mhz design and looking at the BOM, the IC SKY66121-11 is out of production.  Is there a replacement or can you give me a link to still purchase these ICs?
